title: Is Meta(Facebook) back to the AI race with Muse Spark (AI model) release?
description:
Meta has introduced a new AI model, Muse Spark, and it could mark a major step forward in the AI race. In this video, I break down what Muse Spark is, its core capabilities, and why it matters for the future of artificial intelligence.

We explore how this model pushes beyond traditional AI systems with advancements in multimodal intelligence, reasoning, and health-related question answering. More importantly, we discuss what this means for Meta’s position relative to competitors and whether this could signal a serious comeback in the AI space.

Key topics covered:

What Muse Spark is and why Meta built it

Multimodal capabilities (text, image, and beyond)

Advances in reasoning and complex problem solving

Applications in health and knowledge-based Q&A

How this impacts the broader AI landscape and competition

As the AI race accelerates, models like Muse Spark highlight a shift toward more general, capable, and context-aware systems.

👉 Is Meta back in the AI race? Watch to find out.
